summary: Fix a hand-rolled CSV writer/reader (quote escaping, custom delimiters, CR, multi-line fields, whitespace) to RFC 4180.
what_tests_check: Doubled quotes, quoting on delimiter/CR/LF only (custom ; and tab delimiters), verbatim spaces, single-empty-field rows, reading multi-line quoted fields, LF endings, no final newline, only CRLF/LF end rows (not form feed/U+2028), no backslash escapes, randomized round trips across delimiters, export/import regressions.
